exact_statement: For every nonconstant finite uniform-cube Boolean sign f with positive ratio R=H(f)/I(f) and every physical descendant ratio at most R, max_i Inf_i(f)<exp(3)*2^-R. For any least-essential-dimension FEI(K) violator, K>=0, deficit D>0 and actual child reserves S_i>=0, likewise max_i Inf_i<exp(3)*2^-K. For singleton minority Fourier rows e_t,q_t,c_t=4e_t(1-e_t), any lambda>=2/ln2 and any real K, define rho=(1+2^(K-lambda))^-1, r=log2(1+2^(lambda-K)), Lambda_i=sum q_t KL_2(Ber(e_t)||Ber(rho)), A_i=sum q_t[lambda e_t-j(c_t)] and O_i=Inf_i-beta_i. The exact identity D_K(f)+S_i+K O_i+Lambda_i+A_i=r holds on arbitrary roots with actual signed S_i. For a physical pair, complete product-reference row KL G_ij and conditional spectral mutual information Z_ij satisfy Lambda_i+Lambda_j+(K-lambda)(O_i+O_j)=G_ij+Z_ij, hence 2D_K+S_i+S_j+lambda(O_i+O_j)+G_ij+Z_ij+A_i+A_j=2r. The complete pair bank also obeys D_K+S_ij+G_ij+lambda I_ij-J_ij=2r, with nonnegative final channel gap; the analogous block identity has a*r. On critical witnesses all these residuals are nonnegative and minority tail mass at e_t>=u>rho is bounded by (r-D-S_i-K O_i)/(r+(K-lambda)u-h2(u)). Every proper pair of a minimal K-witness has C_ij<12 exp(3)*2^-K. These are weighted structural restrictions and exact reserve identities, not a selected-block theorem or universal FEI resolution.

exact_statement: For any finite uniform Boolean sign and physical block A, with complete product Gibbs row KL G_A, lambda>=2/ln2, rho=(1+2^(K-lambda))^-1 and r=log2(1+2^(lambda-K)), the exhaustion surplus G_A+lambda I_A-J_A-|A|r equals exactly K I_A-L_A, independently of lambda. For disjoint nonempty physical blocks A,B, Omega=L_(A union B)-L_A-L_B obeys the sharp bound |Omega|<=2min(|A|,|B|); actual Boolean tensor extremizers attain both signs. For every nonconstant Boolean seed f, tensor t copies with a two-bit point defect, balance with a fresh literal and activate at one point of k=ceil(sqrt(t)) fair controls: the relevant proper gadget pair has L_A=2p,I_A=p,J_A=C_A=0, exhaustion surplus (K-2)p, while H/I tends to H(f)/I(f), total/max influence tend to0 and mean tends to1. Append two dummy bits and flip one inactive vertex; prime full-support roots retain these limits and pair rate tends to2. For every fixed K>2 and every fixed positive rarity/weakness thresholds the class additionally requiring a paid relevant proper pair has the same extended-real optimal H/I constant as all Boolean signs. If the fixed seed K-deficit is positive all four gadget children eventually violate K. An actual N14 prime full-support example at K=lambda=3 has a strictly paid pair and positive root and all four child deficits; exhaustion alone does not certify the retained terminal.
